name: dwt
setup: x = (1:8)'; xL = (1:16)'; [Lo_D, Hi_D, Lo_R, Hi_R] = wfilters('db2');
expr: [cA, cD] = dwt(x, 'db2'); [cA4, cD4] = dwt(xL, 'db4'); [cAs, cDs] = dwt(xL, 'sym4'); [cAc, cDc] = dwt(xL, 'coif1'); [cAcust, cDcust] = dwt(x, Lo_D, Hi_D);
comment: Sig: [cA, cD] = dwt(x, wname) or (x, Lo_D, Hi_D), with optional 'mode' N-V (only 'sym' supported). 2026-05-08: bit-identical to MATLAB R2025b on the analysis filters after the wfilters Lo_D/Lo_R label-swap fix landed. Custom-filter form added in same commit. Boundary modes other than 'sym' deferred (errors with clear message).
